task.instruction: Discover three new and popular open-source NLP models for language translation released in the past month on Huggingface.

final_answer:
Here are three genuinely new (created within the last month) and popular open-source translation models on Hugging Face, verified against the HF API for creation date, downloads and likes:

**1. tencent/Hy-SimulMT-30B-A3B** — created 22 Oct 2026 · 459 likes · ~1.2k downloads (FP8 variant)
Tencent Hunyuan's real-time *simultaneous* translation model (30B total / 3B active MoE, Apache-2.0). It continuously consumes incoming audio and translates while the speaker is still talking, emitting both translated text and speech, with real-time voice cloning that preserves the speaker's timbre. Covers 36 languages including zh, en, fr, es, ja, ar, ko, ru, th, vi, ms, id, hi. This is the most-liked new translation release of the month by a wide margin.

**2. IndexTeam/Index-Translate-9B-GGUF** — created 2 Oct 2026 · 20 likes · 65.9k downloads
Bilibili's Index-Translate 9B (built on Qwen3.5, Apache-2.0), the most-downloaded new translation model of the month. Supports text translation across **150 languages** and follows fine-grained translation instructions about terminology, formatting, style, structure, context and output length. It also does end-to-end multimodal image-to-text translation. The GGUF build makes it runnable locally via llama.cpp.

**3. IndexTeam/Index-Translate-35B-A3B-preview-GGUF** — created 2 Oct 2026 · 19 likes · 16.6k downloads
The larger sibling: a 35B-total / 3B-active mixture-of-experts variant of the same family, also covering 150 languages with the same instruction-following translation capabilities, released as a preview. Same Apache-2.0 license and GGUF packaging for local inference.

All three are Apache-2.0 licensed and were published between 2 October and 1 November 2026. If you want a single pick: **Hy-SimulMT** for real-time speech translation, **Index-Translate-9B** for broad 150-language text/image translation on modest hardware, and the **35B-A3B preview** when you want maximum quality from the Index family.

judge.rationale: HF API evidence shows the selected translation models were created Oct 2–22, 2026 with downloads/likes and Apache-2.0 tags/licenses, satisfying new/popular/open-source criteria.
